h1: 🌺 Florette: Grown with Heart, Crafted for New York
excerpt: At Buzzy, we celebrate brands that share our love for quality, creativity, and community. Florette is one of those rare finds — a family-run cannabis company redefining what “New York-grown” really means.
html:
At Buzzy, we celebrate brands that share our love for quality, creativity, and community. Florette is one of those rare finds — a family-run cannabis company redefining what “New York-grown” really means.

Born from the vision of a father-daughter team and rooted in small-batch craftsmanship, Florette brings together care, culture, and modern design to create an experience that feels as personal as it is premium.

A Family Story, Planted in New York Soil

Florette began with Luis and Bri Delgado, a father and daughter who saw an opportunity to grow something more than cannabis — to grow a connection.

Luis brought decades of business and cultivation experience. Bri, fresh from design school, brought creative instinct and a clear vision for what a modern New York cannabis brand could be: bold, authentic, and rooted in purpose.

You can often find them at local events, talking with customers, learning, and sharing their journey. That visibility is rare — and it’s exactly what gives Florette its neighborly energy.

“We wanted to create something that reflected our family, our culture, and our love for New York,” says Bri.

Their story reminds us that cannabis is at its best when it’s grown — and shared — by people who care.

Born, Bred, and Only in New York 🌿

Every Florette product starts in Wellsville, NY, where its cultivation facility was one of the first to be licensed in Allegany County.

That local connection isn’t just a detail — it’s the foundation of who they are.
By keeping everything in-state, Florette supports regional agriculture, sustainable jobs, and the communities shaping New York’s new era of cannabis.

It’s the kind of local pride you can taste: fresh, flavorful, and unmistakably homegrown.

The Art and Science of Craft Cultivation

Florette’s team treats cultivation as both precision and poetry.

They nurture a carefully curated library of strains, each selected for its distinct aroma, flavor, and feel. From seed to harvest, every decision reflects an understanding that great cannabis isn’t made quickly — it’s made with care.

Their process blends nature and technology:

      • Mixed-light greenhouses capture natural sunlight while balancing it with controlled lighting.

      • Coconut-coir cloning and automated irrigation keep plants consistent and thriving.

      • Hand-trimming and slow curing preserve the flower’s natural terpenes and structure.

      • Whole flower only. No trim, no shake — just the good stuff.

    Each bud feels intentional, cultivated with the same pride you’d find in small-batch wine or craft coffee.

    Designed for Experience

    Florette’s products invite you to slow down and savor — not just consume.

        • Whole-Flower Pre-Rolls deliver smooth, consistent sessions with pure flower (never shake).

        • Rosin Vapes use solventless extraction to capture each strain’s true terpene profile.

        • Jarred Flower showcases the plant’s color, texture, and aroma, honoring its natural character.

      And then there’s the design: modern, vibrant, and full of personality — a reflection of Bri’s creative background and the brand’s fresh energy.

      Why We Love Florette at Buzzy

      We admire Florette because they’re doing what few brands are: leading with purpose.
      They make premium cannabis approachable, thoughtful, and proudly local — just like the communities we serve.

      Their story proves that cannabis doesn’t need to be loud or exclusive to be exceptional. It just needs to be grown with care and shared with heart.

      Find Florette at Buzzy

      Explore our current selection of Florette flower, pre-rolls, and rosin vapes — available now on our Menu.

      Whether you’re a long-time enthusiast or simply curious, this New York-grown brand offers something to discover, appreciate, and enjoy.Because when passion meets craft, good things grow close to home.
